name: repo-status
description: A live git strip above the prompt: branch, ahead/behind, changed files and the open pull request's checks.

showPullRequest.title: Show pull request
showPullRequest.description: Look up the open PR for the branch with the GitHub CLI (gh), if installed.

githubOnly.title: Only in GitHub repositories
githubOnly.description: Show this bar only when the session folder is a git repository whose remote is on GitHub. Turn off to show it in any git repository.
